name: Quantum computing task: Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate |<psi|phi>
task_prompt: Quantum computing task: Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate |<psi|phi>|^2 between RY(1.048)|0> and RY(0.306)|0>. Compare the estimate from 8192 shots with the analytic overlap cos^2((1.048-0.306)/2). Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
